label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
@Kavya, I saw your post yesterday. With people tagging me, I want to own what I got wrong and clear up a few facts here. I don't want this to become a fight between us, or a pile-on against anyone.

We were in Foundry91 cohort 4 together, with SitterNest and DabbaDost, and had our demo day in March 2026. Before that, you sat with me till 1am in the Koramangala office to fix our Razorpay webhook mess. I haven't forgotten that, or how much you've helped me.

I knew from day one where both applicants worked. I should have called you before making the offers, not sent a WhatsApp after the second offer was accepted. That's on me. You deserved to hear from me earlier, and I'm sorry I didn't make that call.

I also need to correct three things, because they're now being repeated:

We posted a backend developer opening on our LinkedIn page and Instahyre on 14 September. It was open to anyone. The first person applied on 19 September. The second came through his referral two weeks later. Nobody from our side DMed either of them to recruit them.

The offers were 22% above their current CTC, not 40%. Both joined on 3 November.

We do have an ESOP pool. It's small, but it's real and has been on paper since January. The claim that we promised ESOPs we don't have isn't correct.

None of those facts changes the call I should have made. And my failure to call doesn't make those claims accurate. I want to be clear about both without turning this into a public back-and-forth.

I'm not naming the two people. They didn't ask to be part of this, and I'd ask everyone commenting not to name or tag them either. Please don't turn this into a debate about their character or choices.

There are 11 startups in our batch, hiring from the same small pool around HSR and Koramangala. This will come up again. Can we agree on a simple cohort rule: if you're interviewing someone from another batch company, give that founder a heads-up before making an offer? A heads-up, not a request for permission to hire or move jobs.

Kavya, I respect you and value our friendship. I wish I'd handled my part better. I'm open for coffee or a call this week, whenever you're okay with it. I'd rather talk with you than keep talking about each other here.
